title: opum-lore pane: coalesce a person's in-flight refresh, and reset refreshInFlight at session.end (LCLI-705 follow-up (a)/(b))
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from opum-doc DEC-172 (4bi), the ONE follow-up for LCLI-705's round-2 minors (a) and (b). LCLI-705's single-flight `refresh` guard (hooks/register.tsx) currently returns early when a refresh is in flight, so a person's own press can be a SILENT no-op — new behaviour the round-2 review flagged and the shipped prose overstated.

(a) A person's explicit refresh that finds one already in flight is COALESCED, not dropped: exactly one more refresh runs after the current one finishes. Only CLOCK TICKS are skipped in flight (per DEC-172 (4bg)(c)). The pane doc (docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md) and CHANGELOG.md must state that behaviour.

(b) The session.end hook resets `tickInFlight` but not `refreshInFlight`; it must reset BOTH, so the two in-flight guards are cleared consistently across a session boundary.

Minor (c) — an interactive top-level session keeps its pane, bounded to one repository — is ruled INTENDED by (4bi) and is NOT in scope here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A person's explicit refresh that finds one already in flight is COALESCED, not dropped: exactly one more refresh runs after the current one finishes.
Only clock ticks are skipped in flight; a person's refresh is never a silent no-op.
The coalescing behaviour is stated in docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md and in CHANGELOG.md.
session.end resets refreshInFlight as well as tickInFlight.
Both are proved both ways: a test shows a coalesced refresh runs (and that a tick is still skipped), and a test shows session.end clears both in-flight guards.
